caption: All rows profiled. Raw and eligible-row denominators differ. Structural missing values are retained; predictor imputation occurs later inside training folds.
All training rows; cancellations, diversions and arrivals at least 15 minutes late form the outcome. Differences are descriptive and not causal airline rankings.
All training rows with valid scheduled departure time. A time association may also reflect route mix, weather or accumulated delays.
Exact training-period aggregates. The rolling line uses only the preceding seven dates and is descriptive, not a model input.

Uniform hash sample of 100,000 training rows. Display restricted to −60 through 300 minutes; 194 nonmissing observations outside that range remain in the data. Missing arrival outcomes are omitted from this histogram.
November–December holdout, after model and threshold freezing. Average precision is reported separately; it is not trapezoidal PR area.
Read alongside precision–recall and the observed class prevalence.
Threshold chosen from validation scores to respect the validation workload budget; test workload can differ.
Quantile-bin calibration diagnostic; few unique scores may produce fewer than ten points. No claim of calibrated probabilities is assumed.
Validation sample, three repeats. Correlated features may share importance. This is a global predictive association, not a causal or flight-specific explanation.
